name: What is the process for upgrading a bathroom vanity with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for upgrading a bathroom vanity with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for upgrading a bathroom vanity with Frasheski Construction typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. We then assist with material and design selection, offering expertise on various vanity styles, countertops, and finishes. Once decisions are finalized, we provide a detailed proposal. Upon approval, we handle the demolition of the old vanity, prepare the site, and expertly install the new vanity, ensuring all plumbing and any necessary electrical work are completed correctly and to code. We manage the project from start to finish, aiming for a smooth and efficient upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, design and material selection, detailed proposal, demolition, and professional installation of your new vanity.
